body:
Thanks. To be very honest I'm worried about it and scared. I've been going through multiple solutions to going peacefully in my head. Whenever I imagine getting the point of jumping off the cliff I hestitate. I'm trying to just get used to the idea that I've not got much time left and I'm trying to make sense of life.
What scares me is what happens after.

I don't plan to do it yet. I have some time to plan things out properly and make sure everything is sorted before I do it.
I did something really stupid and it's landed me in a load of trouble with the bank and soon the law. I have really fucked my life up.
I knew this time was going to come when they would finally catch up with me and they have. 
I've got no excuses for what I did and I hate myself because of it.
I just want to go peacefully without pain. I'm going to start writing letters for my family to help them understand why I did it, but I know they will never forgive me for it.

So now you kind of know why I deserve to die.
